description: Election Commission - N. Xavier was selected as the member of the Ja-ela Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Ja-Ela Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member. It details the process of nominating a replacement member (Niranjan Xavier) under Section 66 A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content is specifically about electoral processes and filling elected positions at the local authority level, which falls squarely under the Elections classification (Type 7).
